role: AnthropicProvider extension holding request shaping: prompt-cache split of the system prompt, tool declarations (only for sends that carry tools; Anthropic server-side web_search replacing the app's Tavily tool), URLRequest construction through ProviderHTTP.streamRequest, the SSE event reader that rejects a stream cut before message_stop, and the continuation of replies the server web search paused (pause_turn): the reply's raw content blocks are rebuilt from the stream and sent back as the assistant's message, at most maxPauseContinuations times.
types: AnthropicProvider.PausedTurn: struct — the content blocks of a paused reply
AnthropicProvider.ReplyContent: struct — one reply's raw content blocks, rebuilt from its stream events
toplevel: Static serverWebSearchToolName and maxPauseContinuations; the PausedTurn and ReplyContent declarations.

units.does: Splits the composed system prompt at the cache marker (ProviderHTTP.splitOnCacheMarker) into stable prefix and variable suffix, then builds system blocks with only the stable one cache-tagged.

Builds Anthropic tools[] for a send that carries tools: nil when tools is empty (the summarizer, fact extraction and voice interjection never get a billed server search). Otherwise custom declarations for every ToolSpec (dropping the app's own web_search when web search is on), the server web_search_20250305 tool (max_uses 3, WebSearchService.excludeDomains blocked) appended when SettingsManager.settingsSnapshot.enableWebSearch, and a 1h ephemeral cache breakpoint on the last declaration.

branches.effect: returns nil (no tools field, no server search)
filters out ToolSpec named "web_search" (Anthropic rejects duplicate names); else all tools kept
appends serverWebSearch(maxUses:3, blockedDomains: excludeDomains); else nothing
returns nil — unreachable: tools is non-empty, and when the app web_search is filtered out the server tool is appended; else last element replaced with cacheTagged copy

units.does: Returns the same ToolDecl with cache_control {type: ephemeral, ttl: 1h}.

branches.effect: rebuilds server web search with cache

units.does: Builds the POST URLRequest: x-api-key, anthropic-version 2023-06-01, anthropic-beta extended-cache-ttl-2025-04-11, JSON content-type, SSE accept; body JSON-encoded with .sortedKeys. Throws if encoding fails.

Reads a reply's SSE line sequence (the URL session's lines, or a test's) as server-sent events (SSEEvents: a blank line resets the event name, an "event:" line records it, non-empty "data:" payloads become events, task cancellation is checked per line) and passes each event's name and payload to handle(). When the sequence ends, a cancelled task throws CancellationError, so Stop reads as cancellation. A stream that ends before message_stop was cut, and throws URLError(.networkConnectionLost) (ProviderStream maps it to a fallbackable .network) instead of passing a truncated reply as complete. Otherwise returns a PausedTurn with the reply's raw content blocks when it stopped with pause_turn, or nil. On every exit (deferred) flushUsage records message_start's usage if nothing recorded it yet, so a reply that failed after message_start still reports its usage.

branches.effect: flushUsage (no-op once usage was recorded or with no message_start)
loop until the lines end; throws on network error/cancellation; handle(eventName:data:) may throw

branches.cond: task cancelled when the sequence ended

units.does: Runs the body through perform; while the reply pauses, sends the body again with all paused content so far appended as one assistant message (resending), so the chat layer sees one continuous reply. After maxPauseContinuations (3) continuations a reply that still pauses is logged and ends with a '…' text delta and .done.

branches.cond: for the first request and each allowed continuation

units.does: The rebuilt blocks in index order, without text blocks whose text is empty.
One stream event: content_block_start / _delta / _stop go to start / apply / stop; any other event is ignored.
Stores content_block as sent, under its index.

Adds a delta to its open block: text_delta, thinking_delta and signature_delta append to text / thinking / signature; input_json_delta appends to the held partial input; citations_delta appends its citation to the block's citations; other deltas are ignored.

branches.cond: no index, block not started, or no delta

units.does: When the stopped block has held partial input that parses as a JSON object, sets it as the block's input; otherwise the block keeps the input it was sent with (a parse failure is logged by attempt).

branches.cond: no index, no or empty partial input, or not a JSON object

units.does: Appends a string piece to the block's string field (starting from empty).
The same request with one assistant message appended whose content is the paused blocks as raw ContentBlocks.
